raw:
I picked these from known NAS-Bench-201 patterns, not from any benchmark data, so none of them has been checked against the actual accuracies. Strong cells tend to put convolutions on edges 0 and 5, and weak cells tend to have `none` or `avg_pool_3x3`. Hypotheses 1–8 rest on the quality effect. Weak parents sit near the accuracy floor, so a helpful edit gains a lot and a harmful one costs little. Strong parents have little room left, so a helpful edit gains less and a harmful one costs more. Hypotheses 9 and 10 rest on connectivity and on what the edit replaces.
